records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Our total consolidated operating revenues increased 21.7% to $14.81 billion in 2022, compared to $12.17 billion in 2021.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: This increase was primarily due to higher revenue per load and increased load volumes within JBI and JBT, increased average revenue producing trucks and fleet productivity within DCS, and increased revenue in FMS primarily driven by a business acquisition, partially offset by decreased ICS load volume.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Our 2022 consolidated operating expenses increased 21.2% from 2021, while year-over-year revenue increased 21.7%, resulting in a 2022 operating ratio of 91.0% compared to 91.4% in 2021.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Therefore, the reported amounts of assets, liabilities, revenues, expenses and associated disclosures of contingent liabilities are affected by these estimates.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Operating income of the JBI segment increased to $800 million in 2022, from $603 million in 2021.
